title: Single-complex connected-component stalk constancy
statement: Let X be Noetherian, B a commutative Noetherian coefficient ring in max(v,u+1), z a point of X, and U an affine coefficient-sized pro-etale object with slice weak contractibility and image inside the connected component of z. Let K be a bounded standard-derived constant-B module complex on the coefficient-sized etale site, with locally constant finite-type cohomology and Tor amplitude [a,b]. Its explicit geometric stalk at the algebraic closure of the residue field of z is perfect. The exact constant realization of that specified stalk, restricted to the actual slice U, is isomorphic to the restriction of adicFinitePullback X B K. The generic coefficientSliceConstant functor is commutativeSiteDerivedConstantModuleFunctor followed by adicResidueRestriction. This involves one complex over one ring, without an adic tower. The stalk, slice, and realization functors are those of [def-sfb-coefficient-etale-derived-stalk], [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons], and [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor].

proof.text: For each cohomology sheaf, fixed_lisse transports its finite constant charts to fixed-coefficient module-valued sheaves. Lift the geometric point into a chart, transport the chart through the equivalence of sliced sites, and take its fiber. The fiber of a constant sheaf is the model module, so the stalk is finite. Exactness of coefficientEtaleModuleStalk identifies these finite modules with the cohomology of the derived stalk.

source.place: Tag 09C6, first paragraph; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09BI; sites.tex Tag 090K

proof.text: Apply the existing coefficient Tor-amplitude/flat-model equivalence to K and [a,b]. Apply the exact coefficient stalk termwise to this bounded flat model. Its terms are flat by coefficientEtaleModuleStalk_flat, and exact derived functor factorization supplies the isomorphism with the specified stalk of K.

source.place: Tag 09C6, first paragraph; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09BI; sites.tex Tag 090K

proof.text: The bounded flat stalk model and the finite cohomology just proved satisfy the Noetherian bounded-flat-complex perfectness criterion, giving the first conjunct.

source.place: Tag 09C6, first paragraph; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09BI; sites.tex Tag 090K

proof.text: The common-local-stalk-model theorem supplies a covering sieve of U on whose domains the constant realization of the specified stalk and the comparison pullback of K have isomorphic actual-slice restrictions. This local step uses hbounded, hlisse and the connected-component image condition but no weak contractibility or Tor hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 09C6, first paragraph; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09BI; sites.tex Tag 090K

proof.text: Apply coefficient_weaklyContractible_local_iso to those two global complexes and the covering sieve. The affine and weak-contractibility hypotheses give their isomorphism on the actual slice over U. By the unchanged definition of coefficientSliceConstant this is precisely the second conjunct.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficient_connected_stalk_constant
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (z : X) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (hU : IsAffine ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj
      U).left)
    (hweak : AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X U)
    (himage : Set.range
      (((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj U).hom.base) ⊆
        connectedComponent z)
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    (hbounded : ∃ c d : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q →
      IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules
      (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K))
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hTor : HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B) K a b) :
    DerivedCategory.IsPerfect
      ((coefficientEtaleDerivedStalk X B (X.algClosurePoint z)).obj K) ∧
    Nonempty
      ((coefficientSliceConstant X B U).obj
          ((coefficientEtaleDerivedStalk X B (X.algClosurePoint z)).obj K) ≅
        (adicResidueRestriction
          (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) U).obj
            ((adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X B).obj K))
